channel.title: Money Made Simple
channel.description: Plain-English money guides for students and early-career workers: budgets that stick, first-time investing, credit scores and debt payoff, with the maths shown and no hype.

item.title: Retirement savings in your 20s: how much, where to put it, and why starting small works
item.description: Why time matters more than amount, the order to use a 401(k) match, IRA and HSA, how much to aim for, and a worked example of starting at 25 vs 35.

item.title: How to spot a scam text: the signs, the common types, and what to do next
item.description: The red flags in scam texts (delivery, toll, bank and job scams), how to check a message safely, how to report it, and what to do if you clicked.

item.title: How to lower your utility bills: the changes that save the most, including for renters

item.title: Buy now, pay later explained: how it works, what it really costs, and when to skip it

item.title: How to choose a checking account: the fees, features and fine print that matter
